description: Find PumpPill's read for a query: a Robinhood Chain address (0x + 40 hex), a Solana mint (base58), or a ticker such as HOOD. Returns ids for fetch. For a ticker the result is the one contract that clears the gate (alive, $10K+ pool, not flagged HIGH or CRITICAL) with the count of others using the name. No results is an honest miss, not a clean bill. Identifiers only, not questions.
name: search
title: Search PumpPill's index
